title: Maestro Flow Schema
description: Schema for Maestro flow YAML files

appId.title: appId
appId.description: The app ID to launch for testing

name.title: name
name.description: Custom name for the Flow if you don't want to use the filename

env.title: env
env.description: Map of environment variables that should be made available for this Flow

tags.title: tags
tags.description: List of tags that this Flow is part of

onFlowStart.description: This is a hook that takes a list of Maestro commands as an argument. These commands will be executed before the initiation of each flow. Typically, this hook is used to run various setup scripts.

onFlowComplete.description: This hook accepts a list of Maestro commands that are executed upon the completion of each flow. It's important to note that these commands will run regardless of whether a particular flow has ended successfully or has encountered a failure. Typically, this hook is used to run various teardown / cleanup scripts.

label.title: addMedia.label

optional.title: addMedia.optional
optional.description: Indicates if the action is optional.

files.title: addMedia.files
files.description: List of media file paths to add to the device's gallery.

oneOf.description: Object specifying the addMedia with additional properties.

examples.label: Try to add the test pictures to the device

assertNotVisible.title: assertNotVisible

optional.title: extendedWaitUntil.optional
optional.description: Indicates if the action is optional.

inputText.description: Inputs the specified text regardless of whether any text field is currently focused. Unicode characters are not yet supported on Android.

optional.title: inputText.optional
optional.description: Indicates if the action is optional.

launchApp.title: Launch the app.
launchApp.description: Launches the app under test without additional configurations.

appId.description: Specifies the app ID (package name on Android, bundle ID on iOS) to launch.

clearState.description: Indicates whether to clear the app's state before launching. Defaults to false.

clearKeychain.description: Clears the entire iOS keychain. Applicable only for iOS.

stopApp.description: Stops the app before launching. Defaults to true.

additionalProperties.description: Sets the permission state (allow, deny, unset) for a specific permission.

all.description: Sets the permission state for all permissions.

arguments.description: Arguments to pass to the app.

label.title: launchApp.label
label.description: Description of the action to be performed.

optional.title: launchApp.optional
optional.description: Indicates if the action is optional.

pressKey.title: pressKey
pressKey.description: Command to press a specific key on the device or remote. Supports standard device keys and Android TV remote controls.

label.title: pressKey.label
label.description: Description of the action to be performed.

optional.title: pressKey.optional
optional.description: Indicates if the action is optional.

repeat.title: repeat
repeat.description: Command to repeat a set of commands either a specific number of times or until a condition is met.

times.title: Number of times to repeat the commands.

while.title: while
while.description: Condition to evaluate while repeating the commands.

commands.description: The set of commands to execute in each iteration.

label.title: repeat.label
label.description: Description of the action to be performed.

optional.title: repeat.optional
optional.description: Indicates if the action is optional.

runFlow.title: runFlow
runFlow.description: Command to run a flow from a specified file or execute inline commands.

file.title: runFlow.file
file.description: The file path of the flow to run.

env.title: runFlow.env
env.description: Key-value pairs of environment variables to pass to the subflow.

when.description: Conditions to determine whether the flow should run.
when.title: runFlow.when

visible.title: runFlow.when.visible
visible.description: Runs the flow if the specified element is visible. Supports shorthand (string) or a detailed selector (object).

notVisible.title: runFlow.when.notVisible
notVisible.description: Runs the flow if the specified element is visible. Supports shorthand (string) or a detailed selector (object).

commands.title: runFlow.commands
commands.description: Inline commands to execute if not using a file.

label.title: runFlow.label
label.description: Description of the action to be performed.

optional.title: runFlow.optional
optional.description: Indicates if the action is optional.

runScript.title: runScript
runScript.description: Command to run a JavaScript file, optionally passing environment variables and running conditionally.

oneOf.description: The file path of the JavaScript file to execute.

file.title: runScript.file
file.description: The file path of the JavaScript file to execute.

env.title: runScript.env
env.description: Environment variables to pass to the JavaScript script.

when.description: Conditions to determine whether the flow should run.
when.title: runScript.when

visible.title: runScript.when.visible
visible.description: Runs the script if the specified element is visible. Supports shorthand (string) or a detailed selector (object).

notVisible.title: runScript.when.notVisible
notVisible.description: Runs the script if the specified element is not visible. Supports shorthand (string) or a detailed selector (object).

platform.title: runScript.when.platform
platform.description: Runs the script if the current platform matches the specified platform.

label.title: runScript.label
label.description: Description of the action to be performed.

optional.title: runScript.optional
optional.description: Indicates if the action is optional.

scrollUntilVisible.title: scrollUntilVisible
scrollUntilVisible.description: Command to scroll towards a direction until the specified element becomes visible.

element.title: scrollUntilVisible.element
element.description: Selector for the element to scroll until visible.

direction.title: scrollUntilVisible.direction
direction.description: Direction to scroll. Defaults to DOWN.

timeout.title: scrollUntilVisible.timeout
timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds to scroll and look for the element. Defaults to 20000.

visibilityPercentage.title: scrollUntilVisible.visibilityPercentage
visibilityPercentage.description: Percentage of the element visible in the viewport to consider as visible. Defaults to 100.

centerElement.title: scrollUntilVisible.centerElement
centerElement.description: Indicates whether to center the element when it becomes visible. Defaults to false.

label.title: scrollUntilVisible.label
label.description: Description of the action to be performed.

optional.title: scrollUntilVisible.optional
optional.description: Indicates if the action is optional.

swipe.title: swipe
swipe.description: Command to perform swipe gestures with control over start and end points, direction, speed, and optional element targeting.

direction.title: swipe.direction
direction.description: Direction of the swipe gesture. Swiping starts from the center of the screen or the specified element.

id.title: swipe.from.id
id.description: ID of the element to swipe from.

text.title: swipe.text
text.description: Text of the element to swipe from.

start.title: swipe.start
start.description: Start coordinates for the swipe gesture. Can be in percentages (e.g., '90%, 50%') or absolute pixels (e.g., '100, 200').

end.title: swipe.end
end.description: End coordinates for the swipe gesture. Can be in percentages (e.g., '10%, 50%') or absolute pixels (e.g., '300, 400').

duration.title: swipe.duration
duration.description: Duration of the swipe in milliseconds. Longer durations result in slower swipes. Defaults to 400 ms.

label.title: swipe.label
label.description: Description of the action to be performed.

optional.title: swipe.optional
optional.description: Indicates if the action is optional.

tapOn.title: tapOn
tapOn.description: Command to tap on a view, specified using text, ID, point, or detailed selectors.

text.description: Matches element with the specified text. Supports regular expressions.

id.description: Matches element with the specified accessibility ID. Supports regular expressions.

index.description: 0-based index to specify which element to select among similar matches.

width.description: Matches element with the specified width.

height.description: Matches element with the specified height.

tolerance.description: Tolerance to apply when comparing width and height.

enabled.description: Matches element with the specified enabled state.

checked.description: Matches element with the specified checked state.

focused.description: Matches element with the specified focused state.

selected.description: Matches element with the specified selected state.

retryTapIfNoChange.description: Determines whether to retry the tap if no hierarchy change is detected.

below.description: Matches an element that is below another element with the specified text.

above.description: Matches an element that is above another element.

leftOf.description: Matches an element to the left of another element with the specified text.

rightOf.description: Matches an element to the right of another element with the specified text.

containsChild.description: Matches an element that contains a child with the specified text.

point.description: Point on the screen to tap on, either relative or absolute.

containsDescendants.description: Matches an element that has all the specified descendant elements.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the tap action.

delay.description: Delay in milliseconds between repeated taps. Default is 100ms.

waitToSettleTimeoutMs.description: Time in milliseconds to wait for the screen to settle after the tap.

label.title: tapOn.label
label.description: Description of the action to be performed.

optional.title: tapOn.optional
optional.description: Indicates if the action is optional.
